integrity: The exact transform and diffusion stationary law are acknowledged as previously established. The new claim is the rare-scale full stationary LDP and its strict quantitative comparison, subject to a best-knowledge originality assessment. All proof limitations are stated; no independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional free Brownian diffusion, constant-rate Poisson proportional contractions, and the stationary rare-displacement scale under fixed positive diffusivity and contraction rate. No finite-time, non-Poisson, non-linear, or finite-s pointwise error theorem; independent audit not performed.
title: A dilogarithmic stationary large-deviation law and a strict diffusion-approximation tail gap
